review_description: The whole process from start to finish was done in a very professional manner ,I would highly recommend Joel & his company
Joel from Solwave was by far the most professional, reliable and responsive of the solar companies we had quote us. He has obviously invested in business systems to make his business successful.

Joel provided a couple of initial quotes but made a site visit to check out the house in person before finalizing the design.The installation went to plan with everything completed neat and tidy and on time.There was a slight problem with the internet connection for monitoring the system but that didn't affect it's operation and was quickly solved.The system is working well despite the very wet weather over the last couple of months.Overall a very pleasing outcome.
Joel was very persistent in contacting me andCame across as genuine. His customer service has been great

Sales and quotation process very goodInstallation went well, installers were polite and punctual, subject to the very poor weather conditions that occurred at the time. Some changes had to be made to the layout due to min approach to roof ridge, but this turned out well.Customer service very good, grid connection organised.Some problems with Fronius in registering product and confirming warranties, but these all appear to have been at the Fronius end not the installers end.

I found Joel a great help. I had already been to a few suppliers and did a bit of shopping around. I knew what product I wanted and Joel didn't try to sell me other products that he may or may not represent. He was straight up and factual.He was able to install when I asked him to and turned up on time and on the correct day. Unlike most builders/trades.He and his team were polite, punctual and didn't leave a mess on site. I found him great to talk to about the installation and his professionalism was outstanding. We had a few snags with setting up the inverter but Joel liaised with the manufacturer and all was sorted. I didn't have to do a thing.I can not comment on after sales service yet as my install is only a few weeks old at the time of writing this but judging by his personality and demeanor I believe he will stay true to his word and come out and repair any issue that may occur under warranty.I would highly recommend Solwave Energy to all looking at getting Solar.

I finally found someone who I can trust. It’s a mind field out there and Joel put my mind at ease. Joel is an electrician and he was the person who I spoke to on the phone and was the person who installed my system. I am a builder by trade and I can see through dodgy contractors, I trusted Joel from our first conversation. I would definitely recommend Solwave.

I was  referred to Solwave Energy by Solar Quotes.  I liked the fact that Joel was not a “solar salesman” but owns the company, has installed  solar himself and knows what he is talking about. Joel offered to come out to my home, which other companies would not do.During the consultation Joel discussed what my requirements were, the panel placement, type of inverter and explained the whole process in detail.  He did not hesitate to climb on the roof to check measurements.The installation was quick and efficient,  I was kept informed during the whole process by Joel and his crew.  Joel organized all paperwork, grid connection and approvals etc.  I also appreciated the after installation follow ups by Joel.I felt very comfortable with my decision to accept the quote to and have Solwave install my solar system. I found Joel to be down to earth, likeable and very informative.I cannot thank Joel and his crew enough for making my solar experience stress free from start to finish.I would not hesitate to recommend Solwave Energy to anyone  looking to have solar installed.

How easy was that ! Joel and Jai did the best job and easy to deal with all the way through. Joel was one of two that bothered to visit me for quote and information prior to installation. The other one that turned up didn’t even bother to look around , Two didn’t even bother to turn up ! The finished product looks fantastic with black anodised panels that looks just so good on my new painted roof. The system is cranking out all the power I need with plenty feeding in.  I’ll be recommending Solwave Energy Solar to anybody that asks.

review_description: The system was the best quality for a great price.  The service was fast, efficient and on time. I highly recommend this company.

Joel, the business owner was very responsive and came down to the site for the initial assessment and sales pitch. I found him to be very professional and competent about solar tech. The installation was scheduled for a week after the initial visit.Joel and Jay installed the panels and inverter over two days. They were very meticulous and thorough. I am glad they took time to do a good job.After installing, I had to wait three weeks for the electricity retailer to change my meter to properly utilize the new solar system.Overall I am very please with the outcome.

We were very impressed with Joel Pugsley's approach. He was not pushy at the consultation, did not badmouth competitors, as some other consultants did. The explanation was honest, thorough and comprehensive. Joel suggested a different placement to what we initially planned, he took into account real-time shading and our roof configuration.The installation process was efficient and professional, even though our roof tiles are old. We also had a hot water timer installed.After service is great, too. Joel consulted us on the providers and promised impeccable customer service should we require it.Overall, we are very impressed and happy to have chosen Solwave!

Joel was referred to me and it made the job easy. He was on time, respectful and has no issues answering any after installation inspections. Have since recommended him to anyone who mentions the word solar!

I can't rate Joel highly enough, right from the beginning he was easy to deal with, knowledgeable and honest. His quote was extremely competitive and Joel was always happy to answer any of the questions I had. The installation went smoothly and Joel did all the paperwork for the grid connection and assisted with options for energy retailers. Even after everything was completed he's still been happy to answer my queries.

I did a lot of research before committing to solar probably to much. Joel was amazing. Well price, Punctual and got the job done in no time he was easy to deal with and is great always takes a call from me still if I have any questions. Thanks again Joel.
